title: Parse a broken policy beside a baseline and retry the archive commit
description: Parse a broken policy beside a baseline and retry the archive commit
acceptance_criteria: Opening a change fails when .specsync/sdd.json cannot be parsed, including when a workflow-v2 baseline exists.
change finalize commits an archive that was left uncommitted, and its next action says to push that commit before merging.
specsync rules does not treat an escaping principles path as a usable file.

answers.constraints: A broken .specsync/sdd.json must not look like no principles file, including when a workflow-v2 baseline already exists.
